Comments (English): [ Mini Aunt, whose life is prosperous. ] || ---------------- || We are steadily increasing our newlywed household. Both my husband and I love cooking, but we hate washing dishes. Since we always have trouble cleaning up, we naturally wanted to bring in a dishwasher aunt. We live in a happy house, so we are sensitive to things like perforation, but the Media Mini dishwasher is good because it is self-installed without perforation~ Just connect the drain hose and plug it in, and it is complete. It is heavy, so my husband gave us a chance to put it on the sink~ The orange color is not tacky but luxurious. I was worried, but it is refreshing and pretty without any sense of incongruity! At first, I looked at the manual roughly and poured water while it was turned off, and fortunately, there was no error, but the full water check did not work. At this time, if you press the reservation and sterilization buttons at the same time for more than 3 seconds, it will force a drain. It takes about 3 minutes, and when the drain is finished, it is recognized when you put water in again. I had boiled pork for dinner and the dishes were huge. Things like frying pans are too big to fit, but dishes fit well. It is more spacious than I expected. Washing dishes takes up to an hour if you eat and clean up, but I like that I can spend dinner leisurely when I leave it to the dishwasher. I turn it on, wash it, and come out feeling good. If you turn it on in standard mode, after washing, the wind comes out in drying mode and dries it! Since it can run for up to 75 hours, I think I can run it without worrying when I go out. However, it is a bit noisy, so I do not recommend using it at night. I turned it on before going to bed, and the drying noise was so loud that I turned it off and slept with the door open. The next day, it was very dry. The dishes were shiny and shiny. Wow~~ Dishwasher Auntie who enriches life. Affordable price and easy installation~ Highly recommended for beginners^^ If my review was helpful, please click [Helpful] This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): After moving, I was debating whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer.
Comments (English): After moving, I was debating whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer. This was a great opportunity to try it out. The black and white colors are just perfect. It's clean and simple. It's also larger than I expected. I liked that it was self-installation and easy to install. The standard setting took about an hour, and the quick setting took about 30 minutes. However, it doesn't dry well, which can be a bit inconvenient. There's no separate drying function. You have to use the standard setting to finish drying. Afterward, you have to leave the door open. There's no auto-opening function. I guess that's inevitable because it's cheap. Steam sterilization cleans dishes thoroughly. It's a bit noisy, but it's a whole new world. The size is perfect for a family of two. It's a bit tricky to use when there aren't many dishes. Considering the standard setting lasts an hour, I'm curious about the electricity bill. I used to wash dishes in hot water for grease stains, but now I don't have to worry about that anymore. Fact check. Even messy sauce. Even stuck-on rice. Even stubborn grease. From drying to safe storage, a 72-hour air circulation system. The product's internal fan enhances the drying function, generating airflow for 72 hours to remove moisture and odors, allowing you to conveniently store dishes without any additional cleaning. Moisture/Odor. Fan operation cycle: Standard and Powerful modes (not Rapid mode). 72°C high-temperature water for a clean wash. Midea. 72°C high-temperature wash to remove grease. See for yourself if it's cleaned thoroughly! No other features required. Five practical washing modes. With a variety of cleaning modes that focus on only the essential functions, you can leave the dishwasher to do the washing for you! Five washing modes: Standard, Powerful, Eco, Rapid. Don't worry about water overflow! Automatic water level sensor. An alarm sounds automatically when the internal water tank fills. Before using the dishwasher, fill it with water and select a cycle. Space-saving design: No drilling or installation required. The water supply tray allows for convenient placement anywhere, eliminating side or upper space constraints. Water supply tray. Use without space constraints as long as drainage is available. Suitable for use under the sink or under upper cabinets. Despite its compact size, it holds plenty of space. Optimized storage space for 2-3 person households. With the optimal dish storage space for 2-3 person households, you can stop putting off the tedious dishwashing and leave it to the dishwasher. Product details. Upgraded practicality! Thoughtful features for optimal usability. Convenient movable casters. Easy-to-load and remove dishes. This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): It's a bit noisy, but it's a whole new world.

Steam sterilization cleans dishes thoroughly. It's a bit noisy, but it's a whole new world. The size is perfect for a family of two. It's a bit tricky to use when there aren't many dishes. Considering the standard setting lasts an hour, I'm curious about the electricity bill. I used to wash dishes in hot water for grease stains, but now I don't have to worry about that anymore. Sentence (English): Even messy sauce.
Comments (English): After moving, I was debating whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer. This was a great opportunity to try it out. The black and white colors are just perfect. It's clean and simple. It's also larger than I expected. I liked that it was self-installation and easy to install. The standard setting took about an hour, and the quick setting took about 30 minutes. However, it doesn't dry well, which can be a bit inconvenient. There's no separate drying function. You have to use the standard setting to finish drying. Afterward, you have to leave the door open. There's no auto-opening function. I guess that's inevitable because it's cheap. Steam sterilization cleans dishes thoroughly. It's a bit noisy, but it's a whole new world. The size is perfect for a family of two. It's a bit tricky to use when there aren't many dishes. Considering the standard setting lasts an hour, I'm curious about the electricity bill. I used to wash dishes in hot water for grease stains, but now I don't have to worry about that anymore. Fact check. Even messy sauce. Even stuck-on rice. Even stubborn grease. From drying to safe storage, a 72-hour air circulation system. See for yourself if it's cleaned thoroughly! No other features required. Five practical washing modes. With a variety of cleaning modes that focus on only the essential functions, you can leave the dishwasher to do the washing for you! Five washing modes: Standard, Powerful, Eco, Rapid. Sentence (English): From drying to safe storage, a 72-hour air circulation system.
Comments (English): After moving, I was debating whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer. This was a great opportunity to try it out. The black and white colors are just perfect. The standard setting took about an hour, and the quick setting took about 30 minutes. However, it doesn't dry well, which can be a bit inconvenient. There's no separate drying function. You have to use the standard setting to finish drying. Afterward, you have to leave the door open. There's no auto-opening function. I guess that's inevitable because it's cheap. Steam sterilization cleans dishes thoroughly. It's a bit noisy, but it's a whole new world. The size is perfect for a family of two. It's a bit tricky to use when there aren't many dishes. Considering the standard setting lasts an hour, I'm curious about the electricity bill. I used to wash dishes in hot water for grease stains, but now I don't have to worry about that anymore. Fact check. Even messy sauce. Even stuck-on rice. Even stubborn grease. From drying to safe storage, a 72-hour air circulation system. See for yourself if it's cleaned thoroughly! No other features required. Five practical washing modes. With a variety of cleaning modes that focus on only the essential functions, you can leave the dishwasher to do the washing for you! Five washing modes: Standard, Powerful, Eco, Rapid. Don't worry about water overflow! Automatic water level sensor. An alarm sounds automatically when the internal water tank fills. Before using the dishwasher, fill it with water and select a cycle. Sentence (English): Five practical washing modes.
Comments (English): After moving, I was debating whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer. This was a great opportunity to try it out. The black and white colors are just perfect. You have to use the standard setting to finish drying. Afterward, you have to leave the door open. There's no auto-opening function. I guess that's inevitable because it's cheap. Steam sterilization cleans dishes thoroughly. It's a bit noisy, but it's a whole new world. The size is perfect for a family of two. It's a bit tricky to use when there aren't many dishes. Considering the standard setting lasts an hour, I'm curious about the electricity bill. I used to wash dishes in hot water for grease stains, but now I don't have to worry about that anymore. Fact check. Even messy sauce. Even stuck-on rice. Even stubborn grease. From drying to safe storage, a 72-hour air circulation system. Comments (English): After moving, I was debating whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer. This was a great opportunity to try it out. The black and white colors are just perfect. Steam sterilization cleans dishes thoroughly. It's a bit noisy, but it's a whole new world. The size is perfect for a family of two. It's a bit tricky to use when there aren't many dishes. Considering the standard setting lasts an hour, I'm curious about the electricity bill. I used to wash dishes in hot water for grease stains, but now I don't have to worry about that anymore. Fact check. Even messy sauce. Even stuck-on rice. Even stubborn grease. From drying to safe storage, a 72-hour air circulation system. Comments (English): After moving, I was debating whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer. This was a great opportunity to try it out. The black and white colors are just perfect. Fact check. Even messy sauce. Even stuck-on rice. Even stubborn grease. From drying to safe storage, a 72-hour air circulation system. Sentence (English): Despite its compact size, it holds plenty of space.

Sentence (English): Product details.
Comments (English): After moving, I was debating whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer. This was a great opportunity to try it out. The black and white colors are just perfect. It's clean and simple. It's also larger than I expected. I liked that it was self-installation and easy to install. The standard setting took about an hour, and the quick setting took about 30 minutes. However, it doesn't dry well, which can be a bit inconvenient. There's no separate drying function. You have to use the standard setting to finish drying. Afterward, you have to leave the door open. There's no auto-opening function. I guess that's inevitable because it's cheap. Steam sterilization cleans dishes thoroughly. It's a bit noisy, but it's a whole new world. The size is perfect for a family of two. It's a bit tricky to use when there aren't many dishes. Considering the standard setting lasts an hour, I'm curious about the electricity bill. I used to wash dishes in hot water for grease stains, but now I don't have to worry about that anymore. Fact check. Even messy sauce. Even stuck-on rice. Even stubborn grease. From drying to safe storage, a 72-hour air circulation system. The product's internal fan enhances the drying function, generating airflow for 72 hours to remove moisture and odors, allowing you to conveniently store dishes without any additional cleaning. Moisture/Odor. Fan operation cycle: Standard and Powerful modes (not Rapid mode). 72°C high-temperature water for a clean wash. Midea. 72°C high-temperature wash to remove grease. See for yourself if it's cleaned thoroughly! No other features required. Five practical washing modes. With a variety of cleaning modes that focus on only the essential functions, you can leave the dishwasher to do the washing for you! Five washing modes: Standard, Powerful, Eco, Rapid. Don't worry about water overflow! Automatic water level sensor. An alarm sounds automatically when the internal water tank fills. Before using the dishwasher, fill it with water and select a cycle. Space-saving design: No drilling or installation required. The water supply tray allows for convenient placement anywhere, eliminating side or upper space constraints. Water supply tray. Use without space constraints as long as drainage is available. Suitable for use under the sink or under upper cabinets. Despite its compact size, it holds plenty of space. Optimized storage space for 2-3 person households. With the optimal dish storage space for 2-3 person households, you can stop putting off the tedious dishwashing and leave it to the dishwasher. Comments (English): After moving, I was debating whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer. This was a great opportunity to try it out. The black and white colors are just perfect. The standard setting took about an hour, and the quick setting took about 30 minutes. However, it doesn't dry well, which can be a bit inconvenient. There's no separate drying function. You have to use the standard setting to finish drying. Afterward, you have to leave the door open. There's no auto-opening function. I guess that's inevitable because it's cheap. Steam sterilization cleans dishes thoroughly. It's a bit noisy, but it's a whole new world. The size is perfect for a family of two. It's a bit tricky to use when there aren't many dishes. Considering the standard setting lasts an hour, I'm curious about the electricity bill. I used to wash dishes in hot water for grease stains, but now I don't have to worry about that anymore. Fact check. Even messy sauce. Even stuck-on rice. Even stubborn grease. From drying to safe storage, a 72-hour air circulation system. The product's internal fan enhances the drying function, generating airflow for 72 hours to remove moisture and odors, allowing you to conveniently store dishes without any additional cleaning. Moisture/Odor. Fan operation cycle: Standard and Powerful modes (not Rapid mode). 72°C high-temperature water for a clean wash. Midea. 72°C high-temperature wash to remove grease. See for yourself if it's cleaned thoroughly! No other features required. Five practical washing modes. With a variety of cleaning modes that focus on only the essential functions, you can leave the dishwasher to do the washing for you! Five washing modes: Standard, Powerful, Eco, Rapid. Considering the standard setting lasts an hour, I'm curious about the electricity bill. I used to wash dishes in hot water for grease stains, but now I don't have to worry about that anymore. Sentence (English): I REALLY want to love this dishwasher, but I don't.
Comments (English): [ Wish I liked it… ] || ---------------- || I REALLY want to love this dishwasher, but I don't. I've had for five months and am having it replaced today. It looks nice and is very quite running. It just does not always get the dishes clean. Usually a third of the dishes need a rinse or rewash. I find it very finicky to load with things not fitting their place and shifting on their own. Well loaded plates knock into or lean on each other while running. The fold down side racks are pretty useless as either hitting tops of plates or the wash is blocked by the items below. Rack spacing is odd despite changing. Is way too easy to block the rotating water arms and wreck the whole load as something slides down through the rack even slightly. I've never encountered these problems before. The top edges of the drawers need wiping from debris, soap or water once a load is done. There are no lights to signal what stage the drawers are in (Dirty? Washing? Ready to unload? ). Needed magnets on the front. Strongly recommend powered dish soap, not liquid or pods. Family is delighted by the “knock to stop” feature. Does have a light to remind about rinse aid, a bonus.

Comments (English): [ Cleaning the filter is not a quick job! ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for 3 years, delivered in November 2020. It's not like other dishwashers where you just turn the filter and pull it out. The filter has at least 11 screws that have to be removed and you have to disconnect the storm wash and sprayer to get the filter out. It is a very involved job and a poor feature, in my opinion. The second thing about this dishwasher is that I have to thoroughly clean my dishes before I load them, otherwise there are food particles still left on them after the load is done. It's a nice looking dishwasher, and maybe with a water softener it would clean the dishes better, but I would not buy it again. Mainly because of that filter!

Sentence (English): First, I never leave reviews.
Comments (English): [ I'm in love.  ] || ---------------- || First, I never leave reviews. But, this dishwasher deserves it! I struggled with a Bosch for 6 years. Who knew a dishwasher would impact the quality of my life like this? Guess I didn't realize how the daily irritation of a bad dishwasher could adversely impact your time in the kitchen. Kudos to Kitchenaid. I highly recommend this dishwasher. They've done a fantastic job. Thank you!

Sentence (English): Bought this at Costco and have been using about a month.
Comments (English): [ Bosch for Life ] || ---------------- || Bought this at Costco and have been using about a month. We replaced our Bosch dishwasher of 19 years with this one. I love the top rack feature and find I don't use the utensil rack which leaves me more bottom rack room. The 3 level middle rack I typically use in the low position to accommodate my drinking glass height. If I have over- large items I found it's easier to hand wash so I can fit more dishes in bottom rack. I wasn't sure I'd like the hidden controls (our old machine was in front) but not a big deal adjustment. Love love love the red light that shines on the floor when cycle in use. I like the cycle options and for a family of 4 we use the speed cycle which takes 70 min. We usually open dishwasher after cycle complete and shake the racks and leave slightly open until unloaded. We typically rinse our dishes before loading. Checked the food trap at a month and minimal food in filter found. It cleans and dries well. Only negative I can find is you can't program an air dry or no dry in the cycle. I guess why we're in the habit of opening door at end of cycle and letting air dry as our old machine you could. I hope we get 19 years from this machine. □□

Comments (English): [ Excellent wash/dry performance ] || ---------------- || Dishwashers have changed significantly since I purchased my last machine 22 years ago. Having done some research I knew what to expect. My experience with Whirlpool has been entirely positive so my choice of brand was already determined. This model was new to Costco when I purchased it 6 months ago, so I was buying without the benefit of any reviews. In hindsight this was beneficial because some of these reviews don't align with my experience at all. This machine was an excellent value for the price paid, especially so given that delivery, installation, and the installation kit are included. Other retailers charge extra for these items which can easily add an additional 50% to the cost. My Whirlpool order was the two-step process: appliance was delivered and a second appointment was necessary for installation. I had no difficulty with scheduling—I received two text messages, the first offering to confirm a delivery date; the second offering an installation date that was around 2 days later. Both occurred as scheduled. The installer ensured the machine was level and had no leaks. Reviewers mentioning flooding likely had machines that were not leveled. Compared to my old machine I'd consider this dishwasher whisper quiet. It's relative. Cycle times are significantly longer on all dishwashers and that must be expected. The cycles are ample for my purposes. The Quick cycle is about an hour. Normal about 2 hours. Boost is perhaps 20 mins longer than Normal, but Boost provides additional water changes and heats to a higher temp than Normal. Note that the machine contains a filter. This was new to me. The filter is what permits an extended Normal cycle without excessive water changes. The fold-out shelves (LIFT, then fold) are a gimmick IMO but YMMV. Rinse Aid is essential. My dishes come out dry every time, whether I use Normal or Extended Dry. Those having standing water at the end of the cycle either have something caught in the drain hose or the machine is not level. There should be no visible water remaining. Water pools on the bottoms of cups. No dry cycle will ever be long enough to evaporate that water. Try loading your cups sideways—the water jets from all sides so they'll still get clean (open the door mid-cycle and you'll see what's happening in there). The Boost cycle also appears to wash with higher pressure—you can hear the difference. The inside of the tub is plastic while the door is a beautiful stainless steel. Dishwasher cleaner will prevent calcium buildup. This machine has cleaned burnt-on pan residue and dried spaghetti sauce perfectly, I am 100% pleased with its performance. If you need additional features Whirlpool has machines with more options, but for a machine at this price point it exceeded my expectations for cleaning and drying. The only feature I would have liked to have is a countdown timer. It is true that one has no idea how kind it will be before dishes are done. I don't leave appliances running when I'm not home so I avoid starting the dishwasher if I know I'll need to leave in the next 2-3 hours. Lastly, I use Cascade Platinum as my detergent. I don't know the extent to which this matters but I've had excellent results with it.

This model was new to Costco when I purchased it 6 months ago, so I was buying without the benefit of any reviews. In hindsight this was beneficial because some of these reviews don't align with my experience at all. This machine was an excellent value for the price paid, especially so given that delivery, installation, and the installation kit are included. Other retailers charge extra for these items which can easily add an additional 50% to the cost. My Whirlpool order was the two-step process: appliance was delivered and a second appointment was necessary for installation. I had no difficulty with scheduling—I received two text messages, the first offering to confirm a delivery date; the second offering an installation date that was around 2 days later. Both occurred as scheduled. The installer ensured the machine was level and had no leaks. Reviewers mentioning flooding likely had machines that were not leveled. Compared to my old machine I'd consider this dishwasher whisper quiet. It's relative. Cycle times are significantly longer on all dishwashers and that must be expected. The cycles are ample for my purposes. The Quick cycle is about an hour. Normal about 2 hours. Boost is perhaps 20 mins longer than Normal, but Boost provides additional water changes and heats to a higher temp than Normal. Note that the machine contains a filter. This was new to me. The filter is what permits an extended Normal cycle without excessive water changes. The fold-out shelves (LIFT, then fold) are a gimmick IMO but YMMV. Rinse Aid is essential. My dishes come out dry every time, whether I use Normal or Extended Dry. Those having standing water at the end of the cycle either have something caught in the drain hose or the machine is not level. There should be no visible water remaining. Water pools on the bottoms of cups. No dry cycle will ever be long enough to evaporate that water. Try loading your cups sideways—the water jets from all sides so they'll still get clean (open the door mid-cycle and you'll see what's happening in there). The Boost cycle also appears to wash with higher pressure—you can hear the difference. The inside of the tub is plastic while the door is a beautiful stainless steel. Dishwasher cleaner will prevent calcium buildup. This machine has cleaned burnt-on pan residue and dried spaghetti sauce perfectly, I am 100% pleased with its performance. If you need additional features Whirlpool has machines with more options, but for a machine at this price point it exceeded my expectations for cleaning and drying. The only feature I would have liked to have is a countdown timer. It is true that one has no idea how kind it will be before dishes are done. I don't leave appliances running when I'm not home so I avoid starting the dishwasher if I know I'll need to leave in the next 2-3 hours. Lastly, I use Cascade Platinum as my detergent. I don't know the extent to which this matters but I've had excellent results with it.

The prongs for the dishes make it difficult to load many dishes into it as they are at weird angles. This dishwasher holds about 2/3 of the dishes our old 'basic/cheap' one did (that was put in by the remodeler we bought the house from) and many of our pans don't fit at all. It is nice that it uses less detergent because there isn't a prewash cycle, so that saves us money in the long run. Maybe that's why the dishes are always clean? There are only 2 of us, so it usually takes a couple of days to fill it with dirty dishes, maybe that's why they don't always get clean--but it shouldn't matter at this price range.We have an LG washer/dryer set and the signals on them are too quiet as well. (The dryer doesn't signal it's done until you open the door! The controls are confusing and hard to see (for older eyes). We thought we'd like the controls on top, but if you want to check the status, it turns it off and you have to start the cycle again. The prongs for the dishes make it difficult to load many dishes into it as they are at weird angles. This dishwasher holds about 2/3 of the dishes our old 'basic/cheap' one did (that was put in by the remodeler we bought the house from) and many of our pans don't fit at all. It usually cleans the dishes well, but not always. We thought we'd use the steam cycle to really clean the dishes, but it doesn't do any better than the basic wash cycle that takes much less time and energy. LG has a problem with their 'cycle complete' signals--they're too quiet. The detergent door doesn't always close on the first try. It is nice that it uses less detergent because there isn't a prewash cycle, so that saves us money in the long run. Maybe that's why the dishes are always clean? There are only 2 of us, so it usually takes a couple of days to fill it with dirty dishes, maybe that's why they don't always get clean--but it shouldn't matter at this price range.We have an LG washer/dryer set and the signals on them are too quiet as well. (The dryer doesn't signal it's done until you open the door! How stupid is that? ) I had to buy a baby monitor so I could hear the signal one floor up (and I have them set to the highest sound level! )

Definitely worth checking out and investing in this option.

Sentence (English): One thing I noticed when shopping for dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Don't fall for the 10 year warranty line! ] || ---------------- || One thing I noticed when shopping for dishwashers. Each manufacturer only sells each model for a couple of years then they switch it up with new model numbers. This prevents people from going back and listing reliability reviews down the line so when you're reading reviews you only see recent reviews. Most dishwashers have no issues for the first year or two so most of the reviews are good. I took the time to find the "new" updated version of the model I bought in 2020. My old model was LDF5545SS and this is the latest version. I felt it was important to post a review based on owning the dishwasher for 3 years. It was doing fine for the first 3 years then it started making this shrill whining sound during certain parts of the wash cycle and became progressively louder over the next few cycles. I called LG and they told me this was "normal" due to buildup of minerals. I dismissed that and after 45 min on the phone they told me to call a technician to diagnose it and get back in touch with them. The direct drive motor is failing after 3 years! I run the dishwasher an average of 2x per week and clean the filter monthly. The "warranty" only covers a few things for different lengths of time - 1, 5 and 10 years. Luckily, the direct drive motor is supposedly covered for 10 years (parts, not labor). The technician quoted the part at $300 and labor at $200. Obviously, it wouldn't be worth fixing without the part covered. I've requested the part from LG and will update the review with their response. All in all, it's really sad to see the decline in workmanship and reliability in appliances. The old dishwashers ran for 20+ years, you're lucky to get 10 years now which is so wasteful and irresponsible. I am rating this low because I only got 3 years which is ridiculous.

Comments (English): [ I'm in love.  ] || ---------------- || First, I never leave reviews. But, this dishwasher deserves it! I struggled with a Bosch for 6 years. Who knew a dishwasher would impact the quality of my life like this? Guess I didn't realize how the daily irritation of a bad dishwasher could adversely impact your time in the kitchen. Kudos to Kitchenaid. I highly recommend this dishwasher. They've done a fantastic job. Thank you!

Sentence (English): I am very happy with my Bosch 500 series dishwasher (SHP65CM2N) but it took awhile.
Comments (English): [ Well designed, fits more dishes,favors digital app ] || ---------------- || I am very happy with my Bosch 500 series dishwasher (SHP65CM2N) but it took awhile. I owned a Bosch dishwasher before and the controls on the new one are less intuitive and everything is more digitally oriented. For example, the quick start guide that comes with the machine only gives instructions for a start using your cell phone. You have to download an app, scan an OR code, and then you are admitted into the exclusive realm of digital Bosch controls. I do not like depending on my cell phone. I want to turn the dishwasher on at the machine. Bosch assumes that people who buy the 500 series do so because of the digital features so they push their app. That's not me. I bought into the 500 series because it was the most flexible, good quality unit for the money that I could find in the color white.When the Bosch arrived, I had dirty dishes and I did not want to read a 30 page manual. So I looked for another quick start guide. In the User Manual available online, under "Basic Operation," it said 1. Press the On/Off button with a short 1 second press. 2. Select a cycle and option if desired. 3. Press Start. Guess what? There's not an On/Off button on the SHP65CM2N! So I dig into the manual and find out that the button marked "Reset 4 Sec" is the On/Off button. So now I follow the instructions and it still does not start! So I called Bosch. The lady said, "You followed the instructions but did you do the steps while the door is open? " I said "no" and then I said, why was that important step not in the Basic Operation manual? She said everyone has to have the door open anyway to see the buttons. I said that is not true. I can fully see and press them with the door closed.So I tried the sequence with the door open, closed the door, and it worked… as evidenced by a solid red light shinning on the floor. Is that in the manual? No. The QUICK START manual for the 500 series should have all six of these points: (1) Open the door, place unclean dishes in the racks, add detergent and slide the detergent lid closed. (2) Now with the door open, touch the reset button for 1 sec (3) touch the desired cycle button for 1 sec, (4) touch the start/resume button for 1 sec, (5) close the door, (6) the red light shinning on the floor should be constant. If you read enough of the manual, all these points are covered except that the door must be open to set the cycle and turn on the appliance.Another operation that I could not find in the manuals is how to pump the water out of the bottom of the unit. This can be remedied by (1) opening the door, (2) pressing the reset button for 5 sec, (3) closing the door, (4) the red light shinning on the floor should be constant.Another complaint I have is that installation parts are packaged such that you have to pay for some parts you do not need in order to get the parts you do need. For example, I did not need a plug and cord but had to pay for them to get the termination box I needed.Aside from my initiation blues, this is a remarkable machine. I had the previous Bosch for 14 years before the plastic face cracked and the wash cycle always stopped after 1 minute. This one has better organized racks and the third rack at the top is a big success. I can definitely fit more dishes and flat ware in this unit than I could in my old model. The new unit is quieter also. So quiet that if it was not for the red light shinning on the floor, I would not know it was running. Also, Bosch has top notch Customer Service. I called them at least five times. One time, there was a thin film of soap on the dishes at the end of the wash. The agent showed me how to reprogram my unit so the rinse cycle was longer. The reprogramming worked! He also suggested I use a rinse aid but I do not want to add more chemicals to the environment.

Sentence (English): Bought this at Costco and have been using about a month.
Comments (English): [ Bosch for Life ] || ---------------- || Bought this at Costco and have been using about a month. We replaced our Bosch dishwasher of 19 years with this one. I love the top rack feature and find I don't use the utensil rack which leaves me more bottom rack room. The 3 level middle rack I typically use in the low position to accommodate my drinking glass height. If I have over- large items I found it's easier to hand wash so I can fit more dishes in bottom rack. I wasn't sure I'd like the hidden controls (our old machine was in front) but not a big deal adjustment. Love love love the red light that shines on the floor when cycle in use. I like the cycle options and for a family of 4 we use the speed cycle which takes 70 min. We usually open dishwasher after cycle complete and shake the racks and leave slightly open until unloaded. We typically rinse our dishes before loading. Checked the food trap at a month and minimal food in filter found. It cleans and dries well. Only negative I can find is you can't program an air dry or no dry in the cycle. I guess why we're in the habit of opening door at end of cycle and letting air dry as our old machine you could. I hope we get 19 years from this machine.

Sentence (English): I live alone and work.
Comments (English): [ This is amazing :D ] || ---------------- || I live alone and work. For my health, I try to eat as many side dishes as possible when I cook on weekends. I always peel and eat fruit afterward. I've gotten used to washing dishes, so it's not difficult. However, I realized that I was wasting a lot of time on them in my busy daily life, so after much deliberation, I decided to buy a dishwasher. After using it, I was amazed at how it automatically washes my rice bowl, soup bowl, tumbler, plate, ladle, scissors, spoon, and water cup all at once. Wow! I even feel a sense of deprivation (?) as I wonder why I used to wash dishes by hand, one by one, with detergent on a sponge. I love that it is quieter, uses less water and dries as well without a heating element as my old one with a heating element did, so I love the more energy saving part as well. My only issues are the quieter resuls in a noticably smaller interior, so I cannot clean as many dishes as I could in my old one (the interior is smaller to allow for more sound insullation around the outside, but still fit in the same sized space). And I knew that going in from many reviews and I am okay with that, but don't love it. What I do not like is the upper rack is a terrible design with a mix of oddly spaced and sized tines and areas with no tines at all, and this lead to not being able to fill it and having to hand wash far more stuff because small leftover containers (plasitc and silicone) flip over and fill with water. And that same oddly spaced tines is an issue with the bottom rack and cause even less dishes to be able to fit per load. So, love the quiet, the easy to use controls, the count-down clock, the cleaning and th energy efficiency. Do not love the very poorly designed upper rack and the tines design on the bottom rack. So, 4 out of 5. I was originally thinking 3 stars because of the negatives, but when I really thought about it the positives outweigh the negatives so 4 our of 5 stars. The upper rack in whole is so poorly designed and the tines on bottom rack force less than full loads at times as this would otherwise have easliy been a 5 out of 5.

Sentence (English): I am very happy with my Bosch 500 series dishwasher (SHP65CM2N) but it took awhile.
Comments (English): [ Well designed, fits more dishes, favors app use ] || ---------------- || I am very happy with my Bosch 500 series dishwasher (SHP65CM2N) but it took awhile. I owned a Bosch dishwasher before and the controls on the new one are less intuitive and everything is more digitally oriented. For example, the quick start guide that comes with the machine only gives instructions for a start using your cell phone. You have to download an app, scan an OR code, and then you are admitted into the exclusive realm of digital Bosch controls. I do not like depending on my cell phone. I want to turn the dishwasher on at the machine. Bosch assumes that people who buy the 500 series do so because of the digital features so they push their app. That's not me. I bought into the 500 series because it was the most flexible, good quality unit for the money that I could find in the color white. When the Bosch arrived, I had dirty dishes and I did not want to read a 30 page manual. So I looked for another quick start guide. In the User Manual available online, under “Basic Operation,” it said 1. Press the On/Off button with a short 1 second press. 2. Select a cycle and option if desired. 3. Press Start. Guess what? There's not an On/Off button on the SHP65CM2N! So I dig into the manual and find out that the button marked “Reset 4 Sec” is the On/Off button. So now I follow the instructions and it still does not start! So I called Bosch. The lady said, “You followed the instructions but did you do the steps while the door is open? ” I said “no” and then I said, why was that important step not in the Basic Operation manual? She said everyone has to have the door open anyway to see the buttons. I said that is not true. I can fully see and press them with the door closed. So I tried the sequence with the door open, closed the door, and it worked… as evidenced by a solid red light shinning on the floor. Is that in the manual? No. The QUICK START manual for the 500 series should have all six of these points: (1) Open the door, place unclean dishes in the racks, add detergent and slide the detergent lid closed. (2) Now with the door open, touch the reset button for 1 sec (3) touch the desired cycle button for 1 sec, (4) touch the start/resume button for 1 sec, (5) close the door, (6) the red light shinning on the floor should be constant. If you read enough of the manual, all these points are covered except that the door must be open to set the cycle and turn on the appliance. Another operation that I could not find in the manuals is how to pump the water out of the bottom of the unit. This can be remedied by (1) opening the door, (2) pressing the reset button for 5 sec, (3) closing the door, (4) the red light shinning on the floor should be constant. Another complaint I have is that installation parts are packaged such that you have to pay for some parts you do not need in order to get the parts you do need. For example, I did not need a plug and cord but had to pay for them to get the termination box I needed. Aside from my initiation blues, this is a remarkable machine. I had the previous Bosch for 14 years before the plastic face cracked and the wash cycle always stopped after 1 minute. This one has better organized racks and the third rack at the top is a big success. I can definitely fit more dishes and flat ware in this unit than I could in my old model. The new unit is quieter also. So quiet that if it was not for the red light shinning on the floor, I would not know it was running. Also, Bosch has top notch Customer Service. I called them at least five times. One time, there was a thin film of soap on the dishes at the end of the wash. The agent showed me how to reprogram my unit so the rinse cycle was longer. The reprogramming worked! He also suggested I use a rinse aid but I do not want to add more chemicals to the environment.

Sentence (English): Having previously owned a Bosch dishwasher, when we renovated our kitchen decided to stick with Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Beyond Disappointed ] || ---------------- || Having previously owned a Bosch dishwasher, when we renovated our kitchen decided to stick with Bosch. As part of the modern look and having reviewed several positive reviews, we purchased a fully integrated Bosch dishwasher. Looks great once installed. Because it's fully integrated there is no display on the front, wash program progress is projected on to the floor very neat. However, cleaning outcomes are disappointing. Cutlery when using the top cutlery shelf is never fully cleaned even after multiple wash cycles. Same outcome when using cutlery basket. Plates, cups, dishes and all require multiple washes and don't fully dry, even using extra dry option. Which is defeats energy and water saving features. After first service call we were told there is nothing wrong with the dishwasher. Advice was to not use auto wash - use the 60minutes cycle. This made a minor improvement in wash with mixed results. On second service call advice was to your cutlery is too old. With a new dishwasher you should purchase new cutlery plates. So we purchased new plates, cutlery, etc. Same disappointing results. Hence this review. After perserving for 3 years testing different dishwashing tablets, rinse aid. Having lost faith in Bosch brand, now it's time to look for a new dishwasher and it definitely won't' be a Bosch.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening is not supported! (Long review) ] || ---------------- || I received the product through Coupang Experience Group and am writing a review. I always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but I thought it would be a bit small for 6 people, and I had to take apart the storage unit to buy a 12-person one, so I always worried and never bought it. But this time, I got to use a 6-person dishwasher~ Although Media dishwashers are from a Chinese company, they are also used by Samsung and Cuckoo. (They are Media products, but they are being sold under different names.) It seems like a trustworthy brand. The installation is very friendly because it is a rocket installation product. However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick. It is a washing machine hose. I asked to connect it to a thin water purifier hose, and the installer did as I requested. Even if you buy a different dishwasher other than this one, be sure to check the hose size, and if it is a washing machine hose, ask the installer to use a water purifier hose before he comes, and he will bring the female screw and do it well! If you use a water purifier hose, you can drill a small hole if you have to drill a hole! I have attached a photo, so please refer to it! (The dishwasher fills the water before operating, so I have never had a problem with weak water pressure even though it was connected to the water purifier hose.) It is much larger than you think. It is not small just because it is for 6 people, so please check the size before buying. If you have limited space, buy a 2-stage dishwasher instead of a 1-stage dishwasher! I personally think a 1-stage is better if you have space. It is convenient to put in large items like frying pans and pots (Of course, if you use a lot of dishes, you will have to wash them by hand.) I have used it more than 5 times after installation, and although it is for 6 people, the cleaning power is definitely lower than that of a 12-stage dishwasher, but it does a good job of removing grease (old grease cannot be removed, but for hardened grease, you must first wash it before putting it in.) The water temperature is 70 degrees when using the basic course. For reference, it is too hot to wash the dishes by hand, so you cannot use water temperature higher than 50 degrees. Washing the dishes with hot water is very good for removing grease. I roughly washed the dishes and then ran them, and the dishes were very clean and nice. I did the pre-washing, but it was much easier than not doing it because I roughly washed them and put them in the dishwasher and ran them. And even though it was a cheap product, the interior was all stainless steel, which was nice. The interior should be all stainless steel so that the heat is well stored and the moisture is removed a little faster. The door doesn't open right away when you open it, but you can adjust it to various angles. It was convenient because the door was fixed at various angles when you opened it for drying. Also, the detergent compartment looked weak in the picture, but it didn't look that weak when I actually used it. I think you can use it for a long time if you don't use it too hard. Now, I'll talk about the disadvantages one by one. First, this product came out in 2020, so it doesn't have an automatic door opening function. You have to open the door a little when the product is finished. Otherwise, the moisture doesn't dry out. I think that's the biggest disadvantage of this product. Second, why is the course selection like this? The courses are not written in Korean and are P1, P2 ~ P9, but when you first turn it on, P2 is selected as the default course. If you want to change the course, you can press a button to change it one by one, but the problem is that the powerful course that is secretly used a lot is P1, so you can change it like this: P2>P3>,,,>P9>P1, so you have to press the button multiple times. Also, you can only use the set courses, and you can't customize it like adding a rinse. I've gotten used to it now, but I found it a bit uncomfortable. Third, cleaning the filter was a bit inconvenient. You can disassemble the filter according to the manual, but you have to apply a lot of force when removing the filter from the metal plate. However, the metal plate is softer than I thought, so I think it will break if you do it multiple times. So when I clean the filter, I don't disassemble the metal plate, but I plan to clean it with water. Lastly, there is the AS issue with the product. I installed it well and there were no problems with operation, but I think it will be difficult to get AS in the future. The product is serviced by Yui Tech, but when I searched for Yui Tech AS on Naver, there were a lot of bad reviews. In conclusion, I am very satisfied with the overall product, except for the lack of an automatic door opening function. The price is also cheap for a 6-person model, so it seems good for using in a dishwasher. However, considering the possible after-sales service that may occur in the future, I don’t think I can confidently recommend this product to others. The Cuckoo dishwasher with a door opening function is always on sale for 340,000 won on the Cuckoo Naver Store. Samsung’s is sold on Coupang for around 400,000 won. These are also dishwashers made by Media, but the after-sales service is much better, so I personally recommend spending a little more money and buying a Cuckoo or Samsung. If you want something a little cheaper, this product is also good~ ^^ If it can be installed for 12 people and you don't necessarily need 6 people, then going with the 12-person version is the right answer~ I hope this helps you with your dishwasher purchase~ (Review after using it for over a week) I use powder detergent, so the cleaning power is a bit lacking, but I am still very satisfied. I just put the dishes in a bucket filled with water and rinse them with water before putting them in the dishwasher, and only remove the hardened ones, and almost everything is removed. I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

코스가 한글로 안 적혀있고 p1, p2 ~ p9 까지 있는데, 맨처음 전원을 켜면 기본으로 p2 일반코스로 선택이 됩니다. 코스를 바꾸려면 버튼 하나를 누르면 하나씩 변경되는데 문제는 은근 많이 사용되는 강력코스가 p1이라서 p2>p3>,,,>p9>p1 이런식으로 바꿀수가 있어서 버튼을 여러번 눌려야합니다. 그리고 정해진 코스만 이용할 수 있고, 헹굼 추가 이런 사용자 커스터마이징도 안됩니다 ㅠ 지금은 적응하긴 했는데, 전 좀 불편했습니다.  세번째로, 필터 청소하는 게 살짝 불편하더라고요. 설명서대로 필터 분해는 되긴 하나, 철판에서 필터 제거할때 힘을 상당히 많이줘야합니다. 근데 철판이 생각보다 물렁물렁해서 필터 여러번하다보면 파손될거 같더라고요. 그래서 저는 필터청소할때, 철판까지는 분해안하고, 물로해서 청소하려고요.  마지막으로 해당제품의 as 문제입니다. 저는 설치도 잘되었고 작동상 문제는 없지만, 추후 as받을때 좀 힘들거 같더라고요. 해당제품은 유이테크에서 as를 해주는데, 네이버에 유이테크 as라고 검색하니까 악평이 많이 있더라고요.  ✅️결론적으로 저는 자동문열림기능이 없다는 점만 제외하고는 전반적으로 매우 만족합니다. 가격도 6인용중 저렴한 모델이라서 식기세척기 찍먹용으로는 좋은 거 같습니다. 다만, 혹시나 추후 발생할 수도 있는 as를 생각하면 저는 이 제품을 남에게 당당하게 추천은 못할 거 같습니다. 쿠쿠 식기세척기 문열림기능이 있는게 쿠쿠 네이버스토어에서 항시 할인해서 34만원에 팔고 있습니다. 삼성꺼는 쿠팡에서 40만원대에 판매하고 있고요. 얘네들도 미디어에서 만든 식세기이긴 하나, as는 훨씬 좋아서 저는 돈 좀 만 더 쓰고 쿠쿠나 삼성꺼 사는 걸 개인적으로 좀 더 추천합니다. 조금이라도 저렴한 거 원하시면 이 제품도 괜찮고요~ ^^ 혹시나 12인용 설치 가능하고 꼭 6인용이 필요한게 아니면 12인용 가는게 정답입니다~  식기세척기 구매에 도움이 되었으면 좋겠네요~  ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ (일주일 넘게 사용한 후기) 제가 가루세제를 써서 세척력은 좀 부족하긴한데, 그래도 매우 만족합니다 ㅠㅠ 그냥 물 받아둔 통에 그릇들 넣고 식기세척기에 넣기전에 물로 헹구면서 단단하게 굳은것들만 제거하고 넣는데 거의 다 제거됩니다. 자동문열림 없는거 말고는 다 만족해요~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening is not supported! (Long review) ] || ---------------- || I received the product through Coupang Experience Group and am writing a review. I always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but I thought it would be a bit small for 6 people, and I had to take apart the storage unit to buy a 12-person one, so I always worried and never bought it. But this time, I got to use a 6-person dishwasher~ Although Media dishwashers are from a Chinese company, they are also used by Samsung and Cuckoo. (They are Media products, but they are being sold under different names.) It seems like a trustworthy brand. The installation is very friendly because it is a rocket installation product. However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick. It is a washing machine hose. I asked to connect it to a thin water purifier hose, and the installer did as I requested. Even if you buy a different dishwasher other than this one, be sure to check the hose size, and if it is a washing machine hose, ask the installer to use a water purifier hose before he comes, and he will bring the female screw and do it well! If you use a water purifier hose, you can drill a small hole if you have to drill a hole! I have attached a photo, so please refer to it! (The dishwasher fills the water before operating, so I have never had a problem with weak water pressure even though it was connected to the water purifier hose.) It is much larger than you think. It is not small just because it is for 6 people, so please check the size before buying. If you have limited space, buy a 2-stage dishwasher instead of a 1-stage dishwasher! I personally think a 1-stage is better if you have space. It is convenient to put in large items like frying pans and pots (Of course, if you use a lot of dishes, you will have to wash them by hand.) I have used it more than 5 times after installation, and although it is for 6 people, the cleaning power is definitely lower than that of a 12-stage dishwasher, but it does a good job of removing grease (old grease cannot be removed, but for hardened grease, you must first wash it before putting it in.) The water temperature is 70 degrees when using the basic course. For reference, it is too hot to wash the dishes by hand, so you cannot use water temperature higher than 50 degrees. Washing the dishes with hot water is very good for removing grease. I roughly washed the dishes and then ran them, and the dishes were very clean and nice. I did the pre-washing, but it was much easier than not doing it because I roughly washed them and put them in the dishwasher and ran them. And even though it was a cheap product, the interior was all stainless steel, which was nice. The interior should be all stainless steel so that the heat is well stored and the moisture is removed a little faster. The door doesn't open right away when you open it, but you can adjust it to various angles. It was convenient because the door was fixed at various angles when you opened it for drying. Also, the detergent compartment looked weak in the picture, but it didn't look that weak when I actually used it. I think you can use it for a long time if you don't use it too hard. Now, I'll talk about the disadvantages one by one. First, this product came out in 2020, so it doesn't have an automatic door opening function. You have to open the door a little when the product is finished. Otherwise, the moisture doesn't dry out. I think that's the biggest disadvantage of this product. Second, why is the course selection like this? The courses are not written in Korean and are P1, P2 ~ P9, but when you first turn it on, P2 is selected as the default course. If you want to change the course, you can press a button to change it one by one, but the problem is that the powerful course that is secretly used a lot is P1, so you can change it like this: P2>P3>,,,>P9>P1, so you have to press the button multiple times. Also, you can only use the set courses, and you can't customize it like adding a rinse. I've gotten used to it now, but I found it a bit uncomfortable. Third, cleaning the filter was a bit inconvenient. You can disassemble the filter according to the manual, but you have to apply a lot of force when removing the filter from the metal plate. However, the metal plate is softer than I thought, so I think it will break if you do it multiple times. So when I clean the filter, I don't disassemble the metal plate, but I plan to clean it with water. Lastly, there is the AS issue with the product. I installed it well and there were no problems with operation, but I think it will be difficult to get AS in the future. The product is serviced by Yui Tech, but when I searched for Yui Tech AS on Naver, there were a lot of bad reviews. In conclusion, I am very satisfied with the overall product, except for the lack of an automatic door opening function. The price is also cheap for a 6-person model, so it seems good for using in a dishwasher. However, considering the possible after-sales service that may occur in the future, I don’t think I can confidently recommend this product to others. The Cuckoo dishwasher with a door opening function is always on sale for 340,000 won on the Cuckoo Naver Store. Samsung’s is sold on Coupang for around 400,000 won. These are also dishwashers made by Media, but the after-sales service is much better, so I personally recommend spending a little more money and buying a Cuckoo or Samsung. If you want something a little cheaper, this product is also good~ ^^ If it can be installed for 12 people and you don't necessarily need 6 people, then going with the 12-person version is the right answer~ I hope this helps you with your dishwasher purchase~ (Review after using it for over a week) I use powder detergent, so the cleaning power is a bit lacking, but I am still very satisfied. I just put the dishes in a bucket filled with water and rinse them with water before putting them in the dishwasher, and only remove the hardened ones, and almost everything is removed. I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

코스가 한글로 안 적혀있고 p1, p2 ~ p9 까지 있는데, 맨처음 전원을 켜면 기본으로 p2 일반코스로 선택이 됩니다. 코스를 바꾸려면 버튼 하나를 누르면 하나씩 변경되는데 문제는 은근 많이 사용되는 강력코스가 p1이라서 p2>p3>,,,>p9>p1 이런식으로 바꿀수가 있어서 버튼을 여러번 눌려야합니다. 그리고 정해진 코스만 이용할 수 있고, 헹굼 추가 이런 사용자 커스터마이징도 안됩니다 ㅠ 지금은 적응하긴 했는데, 전 좀 불편했습니다.  세번째로, 필터 청소하는 게 살짝 불편하더라고요. 설명서대로 필터 분해는 되긴 하나, 철판에서 필터 제거할때 힘을 상당히 많이줘야합니다. 근데 철판이 생각보다 물렁물렁해서 필터 여러번하다보면 파손될거 같더라고요. 그래서 저는 필터청소할때, 철판까지는 분해안하고, 물로해서 청소하려고요.  마지막으로 해당제품의 as 문제입니다. 저는 설치도 잘되었고 작동상 문제는 없지만, 추후 as받을때 좀 힘들거 같더라고요. 해당제품은 유이테크에서 as를 해주는데, 네이버에 유이테크 as라고 검색하니까 악평이 많이 있더라고요.  ✅️결론적으로 저는 자동문열림기능이 없다는 점만 제외하고는 전반적으로 매우 만족합니다. 가격도 6인용중 저렴한 모델이라서 식기세척기 찍먹용으로는 좋은 거 같습니다. 다만, 혹시나 추후 발생할 수도 있는 as를 생각하면 저는 이 제품을 남에게 당당하게 추천은 못할 거 같습니다. 쿠쿠 식기세척기 문열림기능이 있는게 쿠쿠 네이버스토어에서 항시 할인해서 34만원에 팔고 있습니다. 삼성꺼는 쿠팡에서 40만원대에 판매하고 있고요. 얘네들도 미디어에서 만든 식세기이긴 하나, as는 훨씬 좋아서 저는 돈 좀 만 더 쓰고 쿠쿠나 삼성꺼 사는 걸 개인적으로 좀 더 추천합니다. 조금이라도 저렴한 거 원하시면 이 제품도 괜찮고요~ ^^ 혹시나 12인용 설치 가능하고 꼭 6인용이 필요한게 아니면 12인용 가는게 정답입니다~  식기세척기 구매에 도움이 되었으면 좋겠네요~  ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ (일주일 넘게 사용한 후기) 제가 가루세제를 써서 세척력은 좀 부족하긴한데, 그래도 매우 만족합니다 ㅠㅠ 그냥 물 받아둔 통에 그릇들 넣고 식기세척기에 넣기전에 물로 헹구면서 단단하게 굳은것들만 제거하고 넣는데 거의 다 제거됩니다. 자동문열림 없는거 말고는 다 만족해요~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Sentence (English): It seems like a trustworthy brand.
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening is not supported! (Long review) ] || ---------------- || I received the product through Coupang Experience Group and am writing a review. I always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but I thought it would be a bit small for 6 people, and I had to take apart the storage unit to buy a 12-person one, so I always worried and never bought it. But this time, I got to use a 6-person dishwasher~ Although Media dishwashers are from a Chinese company, they are also used by Samsung and Cuckoo. (They are Media products, but they are being sold under different names.) It seems like a trustworthy brand. The installation is very friendly because it is a rocket installation product. However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick. It is a washing machine hose. I asked to connect it to a thin water purifier hose, and the installer did as I requested. Even if you buy a different dishwasher other than this one, be sure to check the hose size, and if it is a washing machine hose, ask the installer to use a water purifier hose before he comes, and he will bring the female screw and do it well! If you use a water purifier hose, you can drill a small hole if you have to drill a hole! I have attached a photo, so please refer to it! (The dishwasher fills the water before operating, so I have never had a problem with weak water pressure even though it was connected to the water purifier hose.) It is much larger than you think. It is not small just because it is for 6 people, so please check the size before buying. If you have limited space, buy a 2-stage dishwasher instead of a 1-stage dishwasher! I personally think a 1-stage is better if you have space. It is convenient to put in large items like frying pans and pots (Of course, if you use a lot of dishes, you will have to wash them by hand.) I have used it more than 5 times after installation, and although it is for 6 people, the cleaning power is definitely lower than that of a 12-stage dishwasher, but it does a good job of removing grease (old grease cannot be removed, but for hardened grease, you must first wash it before putting it in.) The water temperature is 70 degrees when using the basic course. For reference, it is too hot to wash the dishes by hand, so you cannot use water temperature higher than 50 degrees. Washing the dishes with hot water is very good for removing grease. I roughly washed the dishes and then ran them, and the dishes were very clean and nice. I did the pre-washing, but it was much easier than not doing it because I roughly washed them and put them in the dishwasher and ran them. And even though it was a cheap product, the interior was all stainless steel, which was nice. The interior should be all stainless steel so that the heat is well stored and the moisture is removed a little faster. The door doesn't open right away when you open it, but you can adjust it to various angles. It was convenient because the door was fixed at various angles when you opened it for drying. Also, the detergent compartment looked weak in the picture, but it didn't look that weak when I actually used it. I think you can use it for a long time if you don't use it too hard. Now, I'll talk about the disadvantages one by one. First, this product came out in 2020, so it doesn't have an automatic door opening function. You have to open the door a little when the product is finished. Otherwise, the moisture doesn't dry out. I think that's the biggest disadvantage of this product. Second, why is the course selection like this? The courses are not written in Korean and are P1, P2 ~ P9, but when you first turn it on, P2 is selected as the default course. If you want to change the course, you can press a button to change it one by one, but the problem is that the powerful course that is secretly used a lot is P1, so you can change it like this: P2>P3>,,,>P9>P1, so you have to press the button multiple times. Also, you can only use the set courses, and you can't customize it like adding a rinse. I've gotten used to it now, but I found it a bit uncomfortable. Third, cleaning the filter was a bit inconvenient. You can disassemble the filter according to the manual, but you have to apply a lot of force when removing the filter from the metal plate. However, the metal plate is softer than I thought, so I think it will break if you do it multiple times. So when I clean the filter, I don't disassemble the metal plate, but I plan to clean it with water. Lastly, there is the AS issue with the product. I installed it well and there were no problems with operation, but I think it will be difficult to get AS in the future. The product is serviced by Yui Tech, but when I searched for Yui Tech AS on Naver, there were a lot of bad reviews. In conclusion, I am very satisfied with the overall product, except for the lack of an automatic door opening function. The price is also cheap for a 6-person model, so it seems good for using in a dishwasher. However, considering the possible after-sales service that may occur in the future, I don’t think I can confidently recommend this product to others. The Cuckoo dishwasher with a door opening function is always on sale for 340,000 won on the Cuckoo Naver Store. Samsung’s is sold on Coupang for around 400,000 won. These are also dishwashers made by Media, but the after-sales service is much better, so I personally recommend spending a little more money and buying a Cuckoo or Samsung. If you want something a little cheaper, this product is also good~ ^^ If it can be installed for 12 people and you don't necessarily need 6 people, then going with the 12-person version is the right answer~ I hope this helps you with your dishwasher purchase~ (Review after using it for over a week) I use powder detergent, so the cleaning power is a bit lacking, but I am still very satisfied. I just put the dishes in a bucket filled with water and rinse them with water before putting them in the dishwasher, and only remove the hardened ones, and almost everything is removed. I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

코스가 한글로 안 적혀있고 p1, p2 ~ p9 까지 있는데, 맨처음 전원을 켜면 기본으로 p2 일반코스로 선택이 됩니다. 코스를 바꾸려면 버튼 하나를 누르면 하나씩 변경되는데 문제는 은근 많이 사용되는 강력코스가 p1이라서 p2>p3>,,,>p9>p1 이런식으로 바꿀수가 있어서 버튼을 여러번 눌려야합니다. 그리고 정해진 코스만 이용할 수 있고, 헹굼 추가 이런 사용자 커스터마이징도 안됩니다 ㅠ 지금은 적응하긴 했는데, 전 좀 불편했습니다.  세번째로, 필터 청소하는 게 살짝 불편하더라고요. 설명서대로 필터 분해는 되긴 하나, 철판에서 필터 제거할때 힘을 상당히 많이줘야합니다. 근데 철판이 생각보다 물렁물렁해서 필터 여러번하다보면 파손될거 같더라고요. 그래서 저는 필터청소할때, 철판까지는 분해안하고, 물로해서 청소하려고요.  마지막으로 해당제품의 as 문제입니다. 저는 설치도 잘되었고 작동상 문제는 없지만, 추후 as받을때 좀 힘들거 같더라고요. 해당제품은 유이테크에서 as를 해주는데, 네이버에 유이테크 as라고 검색하니까 악평이 많이 있더라고요.  ✅️결론적으로 저는 자동문열림기능이 없다는 점만 제외하고는 전반적으로 매우 만족합니다. 가격도 6인용중 저렴한 모델이라서 식기세척기 찍먹용으로는 좋은 거 같습니다. 다만, 혹시나 추후 발생할 수도 있는 as를 생각하면 저는 이 제품을 남에게 당당하게 추천은 못할 거 같습니다. 쿠쿠 식기세척기 문열림기능이 있는게 쿠쿠 네이버스토어에서 항시 할인해서 34만원에 팔고 있습니다. 삼성꺼는 쿠팡에서 40만원대에 판매하고 있고요. 얘네들도 미디어에서 만든 식세기이긴 하나, as는 훨씬 좋아서 저는 돈 좀 만 더 쓰고 쿠쿠나 삼성꺼 사는 걸 개인적으로 좀 더 추천합니다. 조금이라도 저렴한 거 원하시면 이 제품도 괜찮고요~ ^^ 혹시나 12인용 설치 가능하고 꼭 6인용이 필요한게 아니면 12인용 가는게 정답입니다~  식기세척기 구매에 도움이 되었으면 좋겠네요~  ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ (일주일 넘게 사용한 후기) 제가 가루세제를 써서 세척력은 좀 부족하긴한데, 그래도 매우 만족합니다 ㅠㅠ 그냥 물 받아둔 통에 그릇들 넣고 식기세척기에 넣기전에 물로 헹구면서 단단하게 굳은것들만 제거하고 넣는데 거의 다 제거됩니다. 자동문열림 없는거 말고는 다 만족해요~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening is not supported! (Long review) ] || ---------------- || I received the product through Coupang Experience Group and am writing a review. I always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but I thought it would be a bit small for 6 people, and I had to take apart the storage unit to buy a 12-person one, so I always worried and never bought it. But this time, I got to use a 6-person dishwasher~ Although Media dishwashers are from a Chinese company, they are also used by Samsung and Cuckoo. (They are Media products, but they are being sold under different names.) It seems like a trustworthy brand. The installation is very friendly because it is a rocket installation product. However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick. It is a washing machine hose. I asked to connect it to a thin water purifier hose, and the installer did as I requested. Even if you buy a different dishwasher other than this one, be sure to check the hose size, and if it is a washing machine hose, ask the installer to use a water purifier hose before he comes, and he will bring the female screw and do it well! If you use a water purifier hose, you can drill a small hole if you have to drill a hole! I have attached a photo, so please refer to it! (The dishwasher fills the water before operating, so I have never had a problem with weak water pressure even though it was connected to the water purifier hose.) It is much larger than you think. It is not small just because it is for 6 people, so please check the size before buying. If you have limited space, buy a 2-stage dishwasher instead of a 1-stage dishwasher! I personally think a 1-stage is better if you have space. It is convenient to put in large items like frying pans and pots (Of course, if you use a lot of dishes, you will have to wash them by hand.) I have used it more than 5 times after installation, and although it is for 6 people, the cleaning power is definitely lower than that of a 12-stage dishwasher, but it does a good job of removing grease (old grease cannot be removed, but for hardened grease, you must first wash it before putting it in.) The water temperature is 70 degrees when using the basic course. For reference, it is too hot to wash the dishes by hand, so you cannot use water temperature higher than 50 degrees. Washing the dishes with hot water is very good for removing grease. I roughly washed the dishes and then ran them, and the dishes were very clean and nice. I did the pre-washing, but it was much easier than not doing it because I roughly washed them and put them in the dishwasher and ran them. And even though it was a cheap product, the interior was all stainless steel, which was nice. The interior should be all stainless steel so that the heat is well stored and the moisture is removed a little faster. The door doesn't open right away when you open it, but you can adjust it to various angles. It was convenient because the door was fixed at various angles when you opened it for drying. Also, the detergent compartment looked weak in the picture, but it didn't look that weak when I actually used it. I think you can use it for a long time if you don't use it too hard. Now, I'll talk about the disadvantages one by one. First, this product came out in 2020, so it doesn't have an automatic door opening function. You have to open the door a little when the product is finished. Otherwise, the moisture doesn't dry out. I think that's the biggest disadvantage of this product. Second, why is the course selection like this? The courses are not written in Korean and are P1, P2 ~ P9, but when you first turn it on, P2 is selected as the default course. If you want to change the course, you can press a button to change it one by one, but the problem is that the powerful course that is secretly used a lot is P1, so you can change it like this: P2>P3>,,,>P9>P1, so you have to press the button multiple times. Also, you can only use the set courses, and you can't customize it like adding a rinse. I've gotten used to it now, but I found it a bit uncomfortable. Third, cleaning the filter was a bit inconvenient. You can disassemble the filter according to the manual, but you have to apply a lot of force when removing the filter from the metal plate. However, the metal plate is softer than I thought, so I think it will break if you do it multiple times. So when I clean the filter, I don't disassemble the metal plate, but I plan to clean it with water. Lastly, there is the AS issue with the product. I installed it well and there were no problems with operation, but I think it will be difficult to get AS in the future. The product is serviced by Yui Tech, but when I searched for Yui Tech AS on Naver, there were a lot of bad reviews. In conclusion, I am very satisfied with the overall product, except for the lack of an automatic door opening function. The price is also cheap for a 6-person model, so it seems good for using in a dishwasher. However, considering the possible after-sales service that may occur in the future, I don’t think I can confidently recommend this product to others. The Cuckoo dishwasher with a door opening function is always on sale for 340,000 won on the Cuckoo Naver Store. Samsung’s is sold on Coupang for around 400,000 won. These are also dishwashers made by Media, but the after-sales service is much better, so I personally recommend spending a little more money and buying a Cuckoo or Samsung. If you want something a little cheaper, this product is also good~ ^^ If it can be installed for 12 people and you don't necessarily need 6 people, then going with the 12-person version is the right answer~ I hope this helps you with your dishwasher purchase~ (Review after using it for over a week) I use powder detergent, so the cleaning power is a bit lacking, but I am still very satisfied. I just put the dishes in a bucket filled with water and rinse them with water before putting them in the dishwasher, and only remove the hardened ones, and almost everything is removed. I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

코스가 한글로 안 적혀있고 p1, p2 ~ p9 까지 있는데, 맨처음 전원을 켜면 기본으로 p2 일반코스로 선택이 됩니다. 코스를 바꾸려면 버튼 하나를 누르면 하나씩 변경되는데 문제는 은근 많이 사용되는 강력코스가 p1이라서 p2>p3>,,,>p9>p1 이런식으로 바꿀수가 있어서 버튼을 여러번 눌려야합니다. 그리고 정해진 코스만 이용할 수 있고, 헹굼 추가 이런 사용자 커스터마이징도 안됩니다 ㅠ 지금은 적응하긴 했는데, 전 좀 불편했습니다.  세번째로, 필터 청소하는 게 살짝 불편하더라고요. 설명서대로 필터 분해는 되긴 하나, 철판에서 필터 제거할때 힘을 상당히 많이줘야합니다. 근데 철판이 생각보다 물렁물렁해서 필터 여러번하다보면 파손될거 같더라고요. 그래서 저는 필터청소할때, 철판까지는 분해안하고, 물로해서 청소하려고요.  마지막으로 해당제품의 as 문제입니다. 저는 설치도 잘되었고 작동상 문제는 없지만, 추후 as받을때 좀 힘들거 같더라고요. 해당제품은 유이테크에서 as를 해주는데, 네이버에 유이테크 as라고 검색하니까 악평이 많이 있더라고요.  ✅️결론적으로 저는 자동문열림기능이 없다는 점만 제외하고는 전반적으로 매우 만족합니다. 가격도 6인용중 저렴한 모델이라서 식기세척기 찍먹용으로는 좋은 거 같습니다. 다만, 혹시나 추후 발생할 수도 있는 as를 생각하면 저는 이 제품을 남에게 당당하게 추천은 못할 거 같습니다. 쿠쿠 식기세척기 문열림기능이 있는게 쿠쿠 네이버스토어에서 항시 할인해서 34만원에 팔고 있습니다. 삼성꺼는 쿠팡에서 40만원대에 판매하고 있고요. 얘네들도 미디어에서 만든 식세기이긴 하나, as는 훨씬 좋아서 저는 돈 좀 만 더 쓰고 쿠쿠나 삼성꺼 사는 걸 개인적으로 좀 더 추천합니다. 조금이라도 저렴한 거 원하시면 이 제품도 괜찮고요~ ^^ 혹시나 12인용 설치 가능하고 꼭 6인용이 필요한게 아니면 12인용 가는게 정답입니다~  식기세척기 구매에 도움이 되었으면 좋겠네요~  ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ (일주일 넘게 사용한 후기) 제가 가루세제를 써서 세척력은 좀 부족하긴한데, 그래도 매우 만족합니다 ㅠㅠ 그냥 물 받아둔 통에 그릇들 넣고 식기세척기에 넣기전에 물로 헹구면서 단단하게 굳은것들만 제거하고 넣는데 거의 다 제거됩니다. 자동문열림 없는거 말고는 다 만족해요~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Sentence (English): However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick.
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening is not supported! (Long review) ] || ---------------- || I received the product through Coupang Experience Group and am writing a review. I always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but I thought it would be a bit small for 6 people, and I had to take apart the storage unit to buy a 12-person one, so I always worried and never bought it. But this time, I got to use a 6-person dishwasher~ Although Media dishwashers are from a Chinese company, they are also used by Samsung and Cuckoo. (They are Media products, but they are being sold under different names.) It seems like a trustworthy brand. The installation is very friendly because it is a rocket installation product. However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick. It is a washing machine hose. I asked to connect it to a thin water purifier hose, and the installer did as I requested. Even if you buy a different dishwasher other than this one, be sure to check the hose size, and if it is a washing machine hose, ask the installer to use a water purifier hose before he comes, and he will bring the female screw and do it well! If you use a water purifier hose, you can drill a small hole if you have to drill a hole! I have attached a photo, so please refer to it! (The dishwasher fills the water before operating, so I have never had a problem with weak water pressure even though it was connected to the water purifier hose.) It is much larger than you think. It is not small just because it is for 6 people, so please check the size before buying. If you have limited space, buy a 2-stage dishwasher instead of a 1-stage dishwasher! I personally think a 1-stage is better if you have space. It is convenient to put in large items like frying pans and pots (Of course, if you use a lot of dishes, you will have to wash them by hand.) I have used it more than 5 times after installation, and although it is for 6 people, the cleaning power is definitely lower than that of a 12-stage dishwasher, but it does a good job of removing grease (old grease cannot be removed, but for hardened grease, you must first wash it before putting it in.) The water temperature is 70 degrees when using the basic course. For reference, it is too hot to wash the dishes by hand, so you cannot use water temperature higher than 50 degrees. Washing the dishes with hot water is very good for removing grease. I roughly washed the dishes and then ran them, and the dishes were very clean and nice. I did the pre-washing, but it was much easier than not doing it because I roughly washed them and put them in the dishwasher and ran them. And even though it was a cheap product, the interior was all stainless steel, which was nice. The interior should be all stainless steel so that the heat is well stored and the moisture is removed a little faster. The door doesn't open right away when you open it, but you can adjust it to various angles. It was convenient because the door was fixed at various angles when you opened it for drying. Also, the detergent compartment looked weak in the picture, but it didn't look that weak when I actually used it. I think you can use it for a long time if you don't use it too hard. Now, I'll talk about the disadvantages one by one. First, this product came out in 2020, so it doesn't have an automatic door opening function. You have to open the door a little when the product is finished. Otherwise, the moisture doesn't dry out. I think that's the biggest disadvantage of this product. Second, why is the course selection like this? The courses are not written in Korean and are P1, P2 ~ P9, but when you first turn it on, P2 is selected as the default course. If you want to change the course, you can press a button to change it one by one, but the problem is that the powerful course that is secretly used a lot is P1, so you can change it like this: P2>P3>,,,>P9>P1, so you have to press the button multiple times. Also, you can only use the set courses, and you can't customize it like adding a rinse. I've gotten used to it now, but I found it a bit uncomfortable. Third, cleaning the filter was a bit inconvenient. You can disassemble the filter according to the manual, but you have to apply a lot of force when removing the filter from the metal plate. However, the metal plate is softer than I thought, so I think it will break if you do it multiple times. So when I clean the filter, I don't disassemble the metal plate, but I plan to clean it with water. Lastly, there is the AS issue with the product. I installed it well and there were no problems with operation, but I think it will be difficult to get AS in the future. The product is serviced by Yui Tech, but when I searched for Yui Tech AS on Naver, there were a lot of bad reviews. In conclusion, I am very satisfied with the overall product, except for the lack of an automatic door opening function. The price is also cheap for a 6-person model, so it seems good for using in a dishwasher. However, considering the possible after-sales service that may occur in the future, I don’t think I can confidently recommend this product to others. The Cuckoo dishwasher with a door opening function is always on sale for 340,000 won on the Cuckoo Naver Store. Samsung’s is sold on Coupang for around 400,000 won. These are also dishwashers made by Media, but the after-sales service is much better, so I personally recommend spending a little more money and buying a Cuckoo or Samsung. If you want something a little cheaper, this product is also good~ ^^ If it can be installed for 12 people and you don't necessarily need 6 people, then going with the 12-person version is the right answer~ I hope this helps you with your dishwasher purchase~ (Review after using it for over a week) I use powder detergent, so the cleaning power is a bit lacking, but I am still very satisfied. I just put the dishes in a bucket filled with water and rinse them with water before putting them in the dishwasher, and only remove the hardened ones, and almost everything is removed. I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
