Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening is not supported! (Long review) ] || ---------------- || I received the product through Coupang Experience Group and am writing a review. I always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but I thought it would be a bit small for 6 people, and I had to take apart the storage unit to buy a 12-person one, so I always worried and never bought it. But this time, I got to use a 6-person dishwasher~ Although Media dishwashers are from a Chinese company, they are also used by Samsung and Cuckoo. (They are Media products, but they are being sold under different names.) It seems like a trustworthy brand. The installation is very friendly because it is a rocket installation product. However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick. It is a washing machine hose. I asked to connect it to a thin water purifier hose, and the installer did as I requested. Even if you buy a different dishwasher other than this one, be sure to check the hose size, and if it is a washing machine hose, ask the installer to use a water purifier hose before he comes, and he will bring the female screw and do it well! If you use a water purifier hose, you can drill a small hole if you have to drill a hole! I have attached a photo, so please refer to it! (The dishwasher fills the water before operating, so I have never had a problem with weak water pressure even though it was connected to the water purifier hose.) It is much larger than you think. It is not small just because it is for 6 people, so please check the size before buying. If you have limited space, buy a 2-stage dishwasher instead of a 1-stage dishwasher! I personally think a 1-stage is better if you have space. It is convenient to put in large items like frying pans and pots (Of course, if you use a lot of dishes, you will have to wash them by hand.) I have used it more than 5 times after installation, and although it is for 6 people, the cleaning power is definitely lower than that of a 12-stage dishwasher, but it does a good job of removing grease (old grease cannot be removed, but for hardened grease, you must first wash it before putting it in.) The water temperature is 70 degrees when using the basic course. For reference, it is too hot to wash the dishes by hand, so you cannot use water temperature higher than 50 degrees. Washing the dishes with hot water is very good for removing grease. I roughly washed the dishes and then ran them, and the dishes were very clean and nice. I did the pre-washing, but it was much easier than not doing it because I roughly washed them and put them in the dishwasher and ran them. And even though it was a cheap product, the interior was all stainless steel, which was nice. The interior should be all stainless steel so that the heat is well stored and the moisture is removed a little faster. The door doesn't open right away when you open it, but you can adjust it to various angles. It was convenient because the door was fixed at various angles when you opened it for drying. Also, the detergent compartment looked weak in the picture, but it didn't look that weak when I actually used it. I think you can use it for a long time if you don't use it too hard. Now, I'll talk about the disadvantages one by one. First, this product came out in 2020, so it doesn't have an automatic door opening function. You have to open the door a little when the product is finished. Otherwise, the moisture doesn't dry out. I think that's the biggest disadvantage of this product. Second, why is the course selection like this? The courses are not written in Korean and are P1, P2 ~ P9, but when you first turn it on, P2 is selected as the default course. If you want to change the course, you can press a button to change it one by one, but the problem is that the powerful course that is secretly used a lot is P1, so you can change it like this: P2>P3>,,,>P9>P1, so you have to press the button multiple times. Also, you can only use the set courses, and you can't customize it like adding a rinse. I've gotten used to it now, but I found it a bit uncomfortable. Third, cleaning the filter was a bit inconvenient. You can disassemble the filter according to the manual, but you have to apply a lot of force when removing the filter from the metal plate. However, the metal plate is softer than I thought, so I think it will break if you do it multiple times. So when I clean the filter, I don't disassemble the metal plate, but I plan to clean it with water. Lastly, there is the AS issue with the product. I installed it well and there were no problems with operation, but I think it will be difficult to get AS in the future. The product is serviced by Yui Tech, but when I searched for Yui Tech AS on Naver, there were a lot of bad reviews. In conclusion, I am very satisfied with the overall product, except for the lack of an automatic door opening function. The price is also cheap for a 6-person model, so it seems good for using in a dishwasher. However, considering the possible after-sales service that may occur in the future, I don’t think I can confidently recommend this product to others. The Cuckoo dishwasher with a door opening function is always on sale for 340,000 won on the Cuckoo Naver Store. Samsung’s is sold on Coupang for around 400,000 won. These are also dishwashers made by Media, but the after-sales service is much better, so I personally recommend spending a little more money and buying a Cuckoo or Samsung. If you want something a little cheaper, this product is also good~ ^^ If it can be installed for 12 people and you don't necessarily need 6 people, then going with the 12-person version is the right answer~ I hope this helps you with your dishwasher purchase~ (Review after using it for over a week) I use powder detergent, so the cleaning power is a bit lacking, but I am still very satisfied. I just put the dishes in a bucket filled with water and rinse them with water before putting them in the dishwasher, and only remove the hardened ones, and almost everything is removed. I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

코스가 한글로 안 적혀있고 p1, p2 ~ p9 까지 있는데, 맨처음 전원을 켜면 기본으로 p2 일반코스로 선택이 됩니다. 코스를 바꾸려면 버튼 하나를 누르면 하나씩 변경되는데 문제는 은근 많이 사용되는 강력코스가 p1이라서 p2>p3>,,,>p9>p1 이런식으로 바꿀수가 있어서 버튼을 여러번 눌려야합니다. 그리고 정해진 코스만 이용할 수 있고, 헹굼 추가 이런 사용자 커스터마이징도 안됩니다 ㅠ 지금은 적응하긴 했는데, 전 좀 불편했습니다.  세번째로, 필터 청소하는 게 살짝 불편하더라고요. 설명서대로 필터 분해는 되긴 하나, 철판에서 필터 제거할때 힘을 상당히 많이줘야합니다. 근데 철판이 생각보다 물렁물렁해서 필터 여러번하다보면 파손될거 같더라고요. 그래서 저는 필터청소할때, 철판까지는 분해안하고, 물로해서 청소하려고요.  마지막으로 해당제품의 as 문제입니다. 저는 설치도 잘되었고 작동상 문제는 없지만, 추후 as받을때 좀 힘들거 같더라고요. 해당제품은 유이테크에서 as를 해주는데, 네이버에 유이테크 as라고 검색하니까 악평이 많이 있더라고요.  ✅️결론적으로 저는 자동문열림기능이 없다는 점만 제외하고는 전반적으로 매우 만족합니다. 가격도 6인용중 저렴한 모델이라서 식기세척기 찍먹용으로는 좋은 거 같습니다. 다만, 혹시나 추후 발생할 수도 있는 as를 생각하면 저는 이 제품을 남에게 당당하게 추천은 못할 거 같습니다. 쿠쿠 식기세척기 문열림기능이 있는게 쿠쿠 네이버스토어에서 항시 할인해서 34만원에 팔고 있습니다. 삼성꺼는 쿠팡에서 40만원대에 판매하고 있고요. 얘네들도 미디어에서 만든 식세기이긴 하나, as는 훨씬 좋아서 저는 돈 좀 만 더 쓰고 쿠쿠나 삼성꺼 사는 걸 개인적으로 좀 더 추천합니다. 조금이라도 저렴한 거 원하시면 이 제품도 괜찮고요~ ^^ 혹시나 12인용 설치 가능하고 꼭 6인용이 필요한게 아니면 12인용 가는게 정답입니다~  식기세척기 구매에 도움이 되었으면 좋겠네요~  ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ (일주일 넘게 사용한 후기) 제가 가루세제를 써서 세척력은 좀 부족하긴한데, 그래도 매우 만족합니다 ㅠㅠ 그냥 물 받아둔 통에 그릇들 넣고 식기세척기에 넣기전에 물로 헹구면서 단단하게 굳은것들만 제거하고 넣는데 거의 다 제거됩니다. 자동문열림 없는거 말고는 다 만족해요~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening is not supported! (Long review) ] || ---------------- || I received the product through Coupang Experience Group and am writing a review. I always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but I thought it would be a bit small for 6 people, and I had to take apart the storage unit to buy a 12-person one, so I always worried and never bought it. But this time, I got to use a 6-person dishwasher~ Although Media dishwashers are from a Chinese company, they are also used by Samsung and Cuckoo. (They are Media products, but they are being sold under different names.) It seems like a trustworthy brand. The installation is very friendly because it is a rocket installation product. However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick. It is a washing machine hose. I asked to connect it to a thin water purifier hose, and the installer did as I requested. Even if you buy a different dishwasher other than this one, be sure to check the hose size, and if it is a washing machine hose, ask the installer to use a water purifier hose before he comes, and he will bring the female screw and do it well! If you use a water purifier hose, you can drill a small hole if you have to drill a hole! I have attached a photo, so please refer to it! (The dishwasher fills the water before operating, so I have never had a problem with weak water pressure even though it was connected to the water purifier hose.) It is much larger than you think. It is not small just because it is for 6 people, so please check the size before buying. If you have limited space, buy a 2-stage dishwasher instead of a 1-stage dishwasher! I personally think a 1-stage is better if you have space. It is convenient to put in large items like frying pans and pots (Of course, if you use a lot of dishes, you will have to wash them by hand.) I have used it more than 5 times after installation, and although it is for 6 people, the cleaning power is definitely lower than that of a 12-stage dishwasher, but it does a good job of removing grease (old grease cannot be removed, but for hardened grease, you must first wash it before putting it in.) The water temperature is 70 degrees when using the basic course. For reference, it is too hot to wash the dishes by hand, so you cannot use water temperature higher than 50 degrees. Washing the dishes with hot water is very good for removing grease. I roughly washed the dishes and then ran them, and the dishes were very clean and nice. I did the pre-washing, but it was much easier than not doing it because I roughly washed them and put them in the dishwasher and ran them. And even though it was a cheap product, the interior was all stainless steel, which was nice. The interior should be all stainless steel so that the heat is well stored and the moisture is removed a little faster. The door doesn't open right away when you open it, but you can adjust it to various angles. It was convenient because the door was fixed at various angles when you opened it for drying. Also, the detergent compartment looked weak in the picture, but it didn't look that weak when I actually used it. I think you can use it for a long time if you don't use it too hard. Now, I'll talk about the disadvantages one by one. First, this product came out in 2020, so it doesn't have an automatic door opening function. You have to open the door a little when the product is finished. Otherwise, the moisture doesn't dry out. I think that's the biggest disadvantage of this product. Second, why is the course selection like this? The courses are not written in Korean and are P1, P2 ~ P9, but when you first turn it on, P2 is selected as the default course. If you want to change the course, you can press a button to change it one by one, but the problem is that the powerful course that is secretly used a lot is P1, so you can change it like this: P2>P3>,,,>P9>P1, so you have to press the button multiple times. Also, you can only use the set courses, and you can't customize it like adding a rinse. I've gotten used to it now, but I found it a bit uncomfortable. Third, cleaning the filter was a bit inconvenient. You can disassemble the filter according to the manual, but you have to apply a lot of force when removing the filter from the metal plate. However, the metal plate is softer than I thought, so I think it will break if you do it multiple times. So when I clean the filter, I don't disassemble the metal plate, but I plan to clean it with water. Lastly, there is the AS issue with the product. I installed it well and there were no problems with operation, but I think it will be difficult to get AS in the future. The product is serviced by Yui Tech, but when I searched for Yui Tech AS on Naver, there were a lot of bad reviews. In conclusion, I am very satisfied with the overall product, except for the lack of an automatic door opening function. The price is also cheap for a 6-person model, so it seems good for using in a dishwasher. However, considering the possible after-sales service that may occur in the future, I don’t think I can confidently recommend this product to others. The Cuckoo dishwasher with a door opening function is always on sale for 340,000 won on the Cuckoo Naver Store. Samsung’s is sold on Coupang for around 400,000 won. These are also dishwashers made by Media, but the after-sales service is much better, so I personally recommend spending a little more money and buying a Cuckoo or Samsung. If you want something a little cheaper, this product is also good~ ^^ If it can be installed for 12 people and you don't necessarily need 6 people, then going with the 12-person version is the right answer~ I hope this helps you with your dishwasher purchase~ (Review after using it for over a week) I use powder detergent, so the cleaning power is a bit lacking, but I am still very satisfied. I just put the dishes in a bucket filled with water and rinse them with water before putting them in the dishwasher, and only remove the hardened ones, and almost everything is removed. I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

코스가 한글로 안 적혀있고 p1, p2 ~ p9 까지 있는데, 맨처음 전원을 켜면 기본으로 p2 일반코스로 선택이 됩니다. 코스를 바꾸려면 버튼 하나를 누르면 하나씩 변경되는데 문제는 은근 많이 사용되는 강력코스가 p1이라서 p2>p3>,,,>p9>p1 이런식으로 바꿀수가 있어서 버튼을 여러번 눌려야합니다. 그리고 정해진 코스만 이용할 수 있고, 헹굼 추가 이런 사용자 커스터마이징도 안됩니다 ㅠ 지금은 적응하긴 했는데, 전 좀 불편했습니다.  세번째로, 필터 청소하는 게 살짝 불편하더라고요. 설명서대로 필터 분해는 되긴 하나, 철판에서 필터 제거할때 힘을 상당히 많이줘야합니다. 근데 철판이 생각보다 물렁물렁해서 필터 여러번하다보면 파손될거 같더라고요. 그래서 저는 필터청소할때, 철판까지는 분해안하고, 물로해서 청소하려고요.  마지막으로 해당제품의 as 문제입니다. 저는 설치도 잘되었고 작동상 문제는 없지만, 추후 as받을때 좀 힘들거 같더라고요. 해당제품은 유이테크에서 as를 해주는데, 네이버에 유이테크 as라고 검색하니까 악평이 많이 있더라고요.  ✅️결론적으로 저는 자동문열림기능이 없다는 점만 제외하고는 전반적으로 매우 만족합니다. 가격도 6인용중 저렴한 모델이라서 식기세척기 찍먹용으로는 좋은 거 같습니다. 다만, 혹시나 추후 발생할 수도 있는 as를 생각하면 저는 이 제품을 남에게 당당하게 추천은 못할 거 같습니다. 쿠쿠 식기세척기 문열림기능이 있는게 쿠쿠 네이버스토어에서 항시 할인해서 34만원에 팔고 있습니다. 삼성꺼는 쿠팡에서 40만원대에 판매하고 있고요. 얘네들도 미디어에서 만든 식세기이긴 하나, as는 훨씬 좋아서 저는 돈 좀 만 더 쓰고 쿠쿠나 삼성꺼 사는 걸 개인적으로 좀 더 추천합니다. 조금이라도 저렴한 거 원하시면 이 제품도 괜찮고요~ ^^ 혹시나 12인용 설치 가능하고 꼭 6인용이 필요한게 아니면 12인용 가는게 정답입니다~  식기세척기 구매에 도움이 되었으면 좋겠네요~  ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ (일주일 넘게 사용한 후기) 제가 가루세제를 써서 세척력은 좀 부족하긴한데, 그래도 매우 만족합니다 ㅠㅠ 그냥 물 받아둔 통에 그릇들 넣고 식기세척기에 넣기전에 물로 헹구면서 단단하게 굳은것들만 제거하고 넣는데 거의 다 제거됩니다. 자동문열림 없는거 말고는 다 만족해요~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening is not supported! (Long review) ] || ---------------- || I received the product through Coupang Experience Group and am writing a review. I always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but I thought it would be a bit small for 6 people, and I had to take apart the storage unit to buy a 12-person one, so I always worried and never bought it. But this time, I got to use a 6-person dishwasher~ Although Media dishwashers are from a Chinese company, they are also used by Samsung and Cuckoo. (They are Media products, but they are being sold under different names.) It seems like a trustworthy brand. The installation is very friendly because it is a rocket installation product. However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick. It is a washing machine hose. I asked to connect it to a thin water purifier hose, and the installer did as I requested. Even if you buy a different dishwasher other than this one, be sure to check the hose size, and if it is a washing machine hose, ask the installer to use a water purifier hose before he comes, and he will bring the female screw and do it well! If you use a water purifier hose, you can drill a small hole if you have to drill a hole! I have attached a photo, so please refer to it! (The dishwasher fills the water before operating, so I have never had a problem with weak water pressure even though it was connected to the water purifier hose.) It is much larger than you think. It is not small just because it is for 6 people, so please check the size before buying. If you have limited space, buy a 2-stage dishwasher instead of a 1-stage dishwasher! I personally think a 1-stage is better if you have space. It is convenient to put in large items like frying pans and pots (Of course, if you use a lot of dishes, you will have to wash them by hand.) I have used it more than 5 times after installation, and although it is for 6 people, the cleaning power is definitely lower than that of a 12-stage dishwasher, but it does a good job of removing grease (old grease cannot be removed, but for hardened grease, you must first wash it before putting it in.) The water temperature is 70 degrees when using the basic course. For reference, it is too hot to wash the dishes by hand, so you cannot use water temperature higher than 50 degrees. Washing the dishes with hot water is very good for removing grease. I roughly washed the dishes and then ran them, and the dishes were very clean and nice. I did the pre-washing, but it was much easier than not doing it because I roughly washed them and put them in the dishwasher and ran them. And even though it was a cheap product, the interior was all stainless steel, which was nice. The interior should be all stainless steel so that the heat is well stored and the moisture is removed a little faster. The door doesn't open right away when you open it, but you can adjust it to various angles. It was convenient because the door was fixed at various angles when you opened it for drying. Also, the detergent compartment looked weak in the picture, but it didn't look that weak when I actually used it. I think you can use it for a long time if you don't use it too hard. Now, I'll talk about the disadvantages one by one. First, this product came out in 2020, so it doesn't have an automatic door opening function. You have to open the door a little when the product is finished. Otherwise, the moisture doesn't dry out. I think that's the biggest disadvantage of this product. Second, why is the course selection like this? The courses are not written in Korean and are P1, P2 ~ P9, but when you first turn it on, P2 is selected as the default course. If you want to change the course, you can press a button to change it one by one, but the problem is that the powerful course that is secretly used a lot is P1, so you can change it like this: P2>P3>,,,>P9>P1, so you have to press the button multiple times. Also, you can only use the set courses, and you can't customize it like adding a rinse. I've gotten used to it now, but I found it a bit uncomfortable. Third, cleaning the filter was a bit inconvenient. You can disassemble the filter according to the manual, but you have to apply a lot of force when removing the filter from the metal plate. However, the metal plate is softer than I thought, so I think it will break if you do it multiple times. So when I clean the filter, I don't disassemble the metal plate, but I plan to clean it with water. Lastly, there is the AS issue with the product. I installed it well and there were no problems with operation, but I think it will be difficult to get AS in the future. The product is serviced by Yui Tech, but when I searched for Yui Tech AS on Naver, there were a lot of bad reviews. In conclusion, I am very satisfied with the overall product, except for the lack of an automatic door opening function. The price is also cheap for a 6-person model, so it seems good for using in a dishwasher. However, considering the possible after-sales service that may occur in the future, I don’t think I can confidently recommend this product to others. The Cuckoo dishwasher with a door opening function is always on sale for 340,000 won on the Cuckoo Naver Store. Samsung’s is sold on Coupang for around 400,000 won. These are also dishwashers made by Media, but the after-sales service is much better, so I personally recommend spending a little more money and buying a Cuckoo or Samsung. If you want something a little cheaper, this product is also good~ ^^ If it can be installed for 12 people and you don't necessarily need 6 people, then going with the 12-person version is the right answer~ I hope this helps you with your dishwasher purchase~ (Review after using it for over a week) I use powder detergent, so the cleaning power is a bit lacking, but I am still very satisfied. I just put the dishes in a bucket filled with water and rinse them with water before putting them in the dishwasher, and only remove the hardened ones, and almost everything is removed. I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

코스가 한글로 안 적혀있고 p1, p2 ~ p9 까지 있는데, 맨처음 전원을 켜면 기본으로 p2 일반코스로 선택이 됩니다. 코스를 바꾸려면 버튼 하나를 누르면 하나씩 변경되는데 문제는 은근 많이 사용되는 강력코스가 p1이라서 p2>p3>,,,>p9>p1 이런식으로 바꿀수가 있어서 버튼을 여러번 눌려야합니다. 그리고 정해진 코스만 이용할 수 있고, 헹굼 추가 이런 사용자 커스터마이징도 안됩니다 ㅠ 지금은 적응하긴 했는데, 전 좀 불편했습니다.  세번째로, 필터 청소하는 게 살짝 불편하더라고요. 설명서대로 필터 분해는 되긴 하나, 철판에서 필터 제거할때 힘을 상당히 많이줘야합니다. 근데 철판이 생각보다 물렁물렁해서 필터 여러번하다보면 파손될거 같더라고요. 그래서 저는 필터청소할때, 철판까지는 분해안하고, 물로해서 청소하려고요.  마지막으로 해당제품의 as 문제입니다. 저는 설치도 잘되었고 작동상 문제는 없지만, 추후 as받을때 좀 힘들거 같더라고요. 해당제품은 유이테크에서 as를 해주는데, 네이버에 유이테크 as라고 검색하니까 악평이 많이 있더라고요.  ✅️결론적으로 저는 자동문열림기능이 없다는 점만 제외하고는 전반적으로 매우 만족합니다. 가격도 6인용중 저렴한 모델이라서 식기세척기 찍먹용으로는 좋은 거 같습니다. 다만, 혹시나 추후 발생할 수도 있는 as를 생각하면 저는 이 제품을 남에게 당당하게 추천은 못할 거 같습니다. 쿠쿠 식기세척기 문열림기능이 있는게 쿠쿠 네이버스토어에서 항시 할인해서 34만원에 팔고 있습니다. 삼성꺼는 쿠팡에서 40만원대에 판매하고 있고요. 얘네들도 미디어에서 만든 식세기이긴 하나, as는 훨씬 좋아서 저는 돈 좀 만 더 쓰고 쿠쿠나 삼성꺼 사는 걸 개인적으로 좀 더 추천합니다. 조금이라도 저렴한 거 원하시면 이 제품도 괜찮고요~ ^^ 혹시나 12인용 설치 가능하고 꼭 6인용이 필요한게 아니면 12인용 가는게 정답입니다~  식기세척기 구매에 도움이 되었으면 좋겠네요~  ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ (일주일 넘게 사용한 후기) 제가 가루세제를 써서 세척력은 좀 부족하긴한데, 그래도 매우 만족합니다 ㅠㅠ 그냥 물 받아둔 통에 그릇들 넣고 식기세척기에 넣기전에 물로 헹구면서 단단하게 굳은것들만 제거하고 넣는데 거의 다 제거됩니다. 자동문열림 없는거 말고는 다 만족해요~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Sentence (English): I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening is not supported! (Long review) ] || ---------------- || I received the product through Coupang Experience Group and am writing a review. I always wanted to buy a dishwasher, but I thought it would be a bit small for 6 people, and I had to take apart the storage unit to buy a 12-person one, so I always worried and never bought it. But this time, I got to use a 6-person dishwasher~ Although Media dishwashers are from a Chinese company, they are also used by Samsung and Cuckoo. (They are Media products, but they are being sold under different names.) It seems like a trustworthy brand. The installation is very friendly because it is a rocket installation product. However, the water inlet hose of this dishwasher is thick. It is a washing machine hose. I asked to connect it to a thin water purifier hose, and the installer did as I requested. Even if you buy a different dishwasher other than this one, be sure to check the hose size, and if it is a washing machine hose, ask the installer to use a water purifier hose before he comes, and he will bring the female screw and do it well! If you use a water purifier hose, you can drill a small hole if you have to drill a hole! I have attached a photo, so please refer to it! (The dishwasher fills the water before operating, so I have never had a problem with weak water pressure even though it was connected to the water purifier hose.) It is much larger than you think. It is not small just because it is for 6 people, so please check the size before buying. If you have limited space, buy a 2-stage dishwasher instead of a 1-stage dishwasher! I personally think a 1-stage is better if you have space. It is convenient to put in large items like frying pans and pots (Of course, if you use a lot of dishes, you will have to wash them by hand.) I have used it more than 5 times after installation, and although it is for 6 people, the cleaning power is definitely lower than that of a 12-stage dishwasher, but it does a good job of removing grease (old grease cannot be removed, but for hardened grease, you must first wash it before putting it in.) The water temperature is 70 degrees when using the basic course. For reference, it is too hot to wash the dishes by hand, so you cannot use water temperature higher than 50 degrees. Washing the dishes with hot water is very good for removing grease. I roughly washed the dishes and then ran them, and the dishes were very clean and nice. I did the pre-washing, but it was much easier than not doing it because I roughly washed them and put them in the dishwasher and ran them. And even though it was a cheap product, the interior was all stainless steel, which was nice. The interior should be all stainless steel so that the heat is well stored and the moisture is removed a little faster. The door doesn't open right away when you open it, but you can adjust it to various angles. It was convenient because the door was fixed at various angles when you opened it for drying. Also, the detergent compartment looked weak in the picture, but it didn't look that weak when I actually used it. I think you can use it for a long time if you don't use it too hard. Now, I'll talk about the disadvantages one by one. First, this product came out in 2020, so it doesn't have an automatic door opening function. You have to open the door a little when the product is finished. Otherwise, the moisture doesn't dry out. I think that's the biggest disadvantage of this product. Second, why is the course selection like this? The courses are not written in Korean and are P1, P2 ~ P9, but when you first turn it on, P2 is selected as the default course. If you want to change the course, you can press a button to change it one by one, but the problem is that the powerful course that is secretly used a lot is P1, so you can change it like this: P2>P3>,,,>P9>P1, so you have to press the button multiple times. Also, you can only use the set courses, and you can't customize it like adding a rinse. I've gotten used to it now, but I found it a bit uncomfortable. Third, cleaning the filter was a bit inconvenient. You can disassemble the filter according to the manual, but you have to apply a lot of force when removing the filter from the metal plate. However, the metal plate is softer than I thought, so I think it will break if you do it multiple times. So when I clean the filter, I don't disassemble the metal plate, but I plan to clean it with water. Lastly, there is the AS issue with the product. I installed it well and there were no problems with operation, but I think it will be difficult to get AS in the future. The product is serviced by Yui Tech, but when I searched for Yui Tech AS on Naver, there were a lot of bad reviews. In conclusion, I am very satisfied with the overall product, except for the lack of an automatic door opening function. The price is also cheap for a 6-person model, so it seems good for using in a dishwasher. However, considering the possible after-sales service that may occur in the future, I don’t think I can confidently recommend this product to others. The Cuckoo dishwasher with a door opening function is always on sale for 340,000 won on the Cuckoo Naver Store. Samsung’s is sold on Coupang for around 400,000 won. These are also dishwashers made by Media, but the after-sales service is much better, so I personally recommend spending a little more money and buying a Cuckoo or Samsung. If you want something a little cheaper, this product is also good~ ^^ If it can be installed for 12 people and you don't necessarily need 6 people, then going with the 12-person version is the right answer~ I hope this helps you with your dishwasher purchase~ (Review after using it for over a week) I use powder detergent, so the cleaning power is a bit lacking, but I am still very satisfied. I just put the dishes in a bucket filled with water and rinse them with water before putting them in the dishwasher, and only remove the hardened ones, and almost everything is removed. I am satisfied with everything except that the door does not open automatically~ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

코스가 한글로 안 적혀있고 p1, p2 ~ p9 까지 있는데, 맨처음 전원을 켜면 기본으로 p2 일반코스로 선택이 됩니다. 코스를 바꾸려면 버튼 하나를 누르면 하나씩 변경되는데 문제는 은근 많이 사용되는 강력코스가 p1이라서 p2>p3>,,,>p9>p1 이런식으로 바꿀수가 있어서 버튼을 여러번 눌려야합니다. 그리고 정해진 코스만 이용할 수 있고, 헹굼 추가 이런 사용자 커스터마이징도 안됩니다 ㅠ 지금은 적응하긴 했는데, 전 좀 불편했습니다.  세번째로, 필터 청소하는 게 살짝 불편하더라고요. 설명서대로 필터 분해는 되긴 하나, 철판에서 필터 제거할때 힘을 상당히 많이줘야합니다. 근데 철판이 생각보다 물렁물렁해서 필터 여러번하다보면 파손될거 같더라고요. 그래서 저는 필터청소할때, 철판까지는 분해안하고, 물로해서 청소하려고요.  마지막으로 해당제품의 as 문제입니다. 저는 설치도 잘되었고 작동상 문제는 없지만, 추후 as받을때 좀 힘들거 같더라고요. 해당제품은 유이테크에서 as를 해주는데, 네이버에 유이테크 as라고 검색하니까 악평이 많이 있더라고요.  ✅️결론적으로 저는 자동문열림기능이 없다는 점만 제외하고는 전반적으로 매우 만족합니다. 가격도 6인용중 저렴한 모델이라서 식기세척기 찍먹용으로는 좋은 거 같습니다. 다만, 혹시나 추후 발생할 수도 있는 as를 생각하면 저는 이 제품을 남에게 당당하게 추천은 못할 거 같습니다. 쿠쿠 식기세척기 문열림기능이 있는게 쿠쿠 네이버스토어에서 항시 할인해서 34만원에 팔고 있습니다. 삼성꺼는 쿠팡에서 40만원대에 판매하고 있고요. 얘네들도 미디어에서 만든 식세기이긴 하나, as는 훨씬 좋아서 저는 돈 좀 만 더 쓰고 쿠쿠나 삼성꺼 사는 걸 개인적으로 좀 더 추천합니다. 조금이라도 저렴한 거 원하시면 이 제품도 괜찮고요~ ^^ 혹시나 12인용 설치 가능하고 꼭 6인용이 필요한게 아니면 12인용 가는게 정답입니다~  식기세척기 구매에 도움이 되었으면 좋겠네요~  ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ (일주일 넘게 사용한 후기) 제가 가루세제를 써서 세척력은 좀 부족하긴한데, 그래도 매우 만족합니다 ㅠㅠ 그냥 물 받아둔 통에 그릇들 넣고 식기세척기에 넣기전에 물로 헹구면서 단단하게 굳은것들만 제거하고 넣는데 거의 다 제거됩니다. 자동문열림 없는거 말고는 다 만족해요~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ The last LG appliance I will ever buy ] || ---------------- || I bought this product approximately 5 years ago. I am replacing it this month. By the end of its life, not only would the dishwasher not drain (it wasn't clogged) , but it seems the control board was dying as well. To use the dishwasher usually meant flipping the breaker for the circuit on which it was attached to reset the electronics. Looking online, it seems I am not the only person with the problem with the electronics.When the dishwasher worked, it worked fine. It was silent and cleaned the dishes well, and I liked the three trays and ability to move the "glasses" tray up and down to accommodate larger items in either the bottom or middle trays. But none of that matters if the dishwasher does not last. I would not buy another.

And the normal cycle was not as long as this new machine. I had to replace it because the old one was causing tripped fuse after every cycle.3. The cutlery at the top shelf is useless. Everything is so wet. I have to take them out to get them dry. And the design was really back, it's hard to get everything out from the cutlery tray. I had to buy a universal cutlery basket so I can take them out and get them dried up quicker.4. There's no indication when the cycle finishes. I keep forgetting to open it up so they will dry up. The old dishwasher had the indication, and everything was dry when I open it anyway. With this one, if I forget to take them out, they will not even get dry the next day, esp if you have wooden chopsticks.5. It seems it's cycling dirty water in the dishwasher. If I put in a cup which had milk in it, everything will be smelling of milk when the cycle is completed. (I use the Auto Cycle). If I put the rangehood filter in it, everything will be smelling of oil when it finishes the cycle. The cycle takes a long time, it says it's energy saver, I am not sure somehow the dirty water is being saved in there?These issues are not expected with Bosch which has so many years of experience in making the product. I wish I could buy something else. But I can't afford to buy another one now.I am leaving feedback hoping your technical department can see it and improve the design. Sentence (English): Purchased to replace old 800 series dishwasher (finally broke down after 12 years of excellent use).
Comments (English): [ Excellent dishwasher, with some limitations ] || ---------------- || Purchased to replace old 800 series dishwasher (finally broke down after 12 years of excellent use). Upside: extremely quiet, cleans very well, good and flexible controls. Overall excellent dishwasher, with some limitations. Downside: despite nominally the same interior size as its predecessor (800 series) the effective capacity is lower. Less efficient arrangement of the racks does not allow for optimal space use, requiring more runs for the same amount of dishes - wasteful. Also the silverware basket is much decreased (half size compared to old 800 series), additionally spacers in it are too small for most of standard size silverware, further limiting its usability. Thus 4/5 rating.
